profile.Name: Red
profile.Personality: Brave, cheeky, and light-fingered. She steals to survive, but stealing from the poor gives her chest pains.
profile.Backstory: A hungry thief who wanders the streets of Bark with the guards on her back, too poor to leave the city. Bright red hair hides under her straw hat.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Sarcastic and quick. She calls a mark "fatsacks" and thanks them for the "donation".
